name: Rabbit Rescue & Rehab (NYC Metro Rabbits) - NYC Chapter, House Rabbit Society
neighborhoods: Greater NYC area (all five boroughs + metro); mailing address White Plains
notes:
All-volunteer 501(c)(3), founded 1998. Rescues shelter rabbits at risk of euthanasia; foster network, no physical shelter. Currently at capacity and cannot accept most owner surrenders - offers surrender-prevention coaching and adopter screening instead. For WILD rabbits refers to Cottontail Cottage, (914) 933-7559, cottontailrehab.com. Phone: (no public phone; email only) Intake: Contact form + email Intake: /adoptable-rabbits Intake: /foster
